basis: The foundation's own donations page calls it an associative structure under Beninese law and a private structure.

governance.parent: Fundación Raquel Schwartz de Vargas (Fundación RSV)

basis: Kiosko's site credits it as a project of Fundación RSV, whose own about page describes a foundation with a board of private individuals and presents Kiosko as its project.

governance.parent: Secretaria de Estado de Cultura e Economia Criativa do Rio de Janeiro

basis: The centre's project page calls it a cultural centre of the Rio de Janeiro state government attached to the state culture secretariat, and says it was renamed Casa Brasil in 2025.
The institute's own 2023 open call says it was created in 2017 as a non-profit organization.
The museum's quem somos page calls it a public facility of the Rio city government managed by IDG, the Instituto de Desenvolvimento e Gestão.

governance.parent: Instituto do Patrimônio Artístico e Cultural da Bahia (Ipac), attached to the Secretaria de Cultura do Estado da Bahia

basis: The Ipac museums page says the museum is linked directly to Ipac, and the Ipac presentation page calls Ipac a unit attached to the state culture secretariat.

The statute registered in May 2025 (arts. 20 and 22, and the board's power to create staff posts) gives the Conselho Deliberativo the election of the executive board and the approval of the annual budget; the site's terms of use call the institute a private association.

governance.parent: Ministère de la Communication, de la Culture, des Arts et du Tourisme

basis: The 2024 call for applications says the culture ministry launches the 14th edition and pays the artists' fees, travel and stay.
